sents.t: Emma has studied art at Oakville College for four years, and this month she has finally finished!
On Friday, her graduation ceremony took place in the college stadium.
The students wore black caps and gowns.
When the president called “Emma Walsh,” we all stood up and cheered.
After the ceremony, the students threw their caps into the air.
“What are you going to do now?” her father asked.
“I have some news. I’ve gotten a job! A design company in Chicago has hired me as a junior illustrator.”
Emma has worked at Oakville Books since she was nineteen.
“I’ve always known you’re very talented,” he said.
Emma is going to move to Chicago in July.
“Chicago is only a four-hour drive,” she said.
That night, we had a party at Rosa’s.
Emma gave each of us a small painting.
Mine shows me and Max on Maple Street in the snow.
